title: Normalize app-platform root-folder sentinel before assigning parentUID
answers: Root folder from app-platform search is treated as if it has a parent
isRootFolderUID is needed before using item.folder as parentUID
Why does the managed root folder show up nested / lose its badge in the app-platform folder tree?
parentUID wrong for root folders coming from searchDashboardsAndFolders
body: The app-platform search API returns `folder` as a sentinel (e.g. 'general') for root-level items instead of an empty/undefined value. useFoldersQueryAppPlatform (public/app/core/components/NestedFolderPicker/useFoldersQueryAppPlatform.ts) previously assigned `parentUID: item.folder` directly, which made root folders look like they had a parent to any code using `!item.parentUID` as the "is root" check (e.g. badge visibility, tree root detection). Fix: wrap with `isRootFolderUID(item.folder) ? undefined : item.folder` (from app/features/search/constants) before setting parentUID. Apply this normalization anywhere a DashboardViewItem-shaped object is built from raw app-platform search hits and `folder` is mapped to `parentUID`.
applies: Code mapping app-platform search/folder API responses into DashboardViewItem/DashboardsTreeItem shapes (useFoldersQueryAppPlatform and similar hooks).
says: Root folder appears nested in folder picker when selected from search
Root folder loses its special badge after being picked from app-platform search
Why is root folder showing as a child in the folder tree
Root folder incorrectly assigned a parent folder value
Managed root folder should not show as nested in the picker
search: When mapping app-platform search API responses to DashboardViewItem shapes, normalize the root-folder sentinel value returned by the `folder` field before assigning it to `parentUID`. The app-platform search API returns sentinels like 'general' instead of empty/undefined for root-level items, so code using `!item.parentUID` as the "is root" check (badge visibility, tree root detection) incorrectly treats root folders as having parents. Apply the fix `isRootFolderUID(item.folder) ? undefined : item.folder` from public/app/features/search/constants.ts before setting parentUID in hooks like useFoldersQueryAppPlatform (public/app/core/components/NestedFolderPicker/useFoldersQueryAppPlatform.ts) and similar folder API consumers.
